svg.text: Heavy arrows are region hand-offs; the cyan one is the HTTP response. Light arrows are steps inside a region. A layer that does not exist is drawn as a note or listed in the band — never as an implemented step.
Ownership is enforced inside the delete filter itself, which is why a foreign id and a missing id produce exactly the same 404.
